read.title: L/C Details for Order #2251
read.text:
Dear Mr. Haddad,

Thank you for your order of 8,000 sheet masks. We have yet to receive the letter of credit from your bank, and we would like to confirm a few details before it is issued.

Please make sure that our company, Sunrise Cosmetics Co., Ltd., is listed as the beneficiary and that the latest shipment date is December 20. Partial shipments should also be allowed.

If any changes are needed after the L/C is opened, please send the amendment prior to shipment. Otherwise, the bank may refuse payment due to discrepancies.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee

write.en: Write an email telling a buyer you have not received the L/C yet and asking them to confirm the beneficiary and shipment date.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Novak,

We have yet to receive the letter of credit for order #1180. Could you check the status with your bank? Please also confirm that our company is listed as the beneficiary and that the latest shipment date is January 15. If any amendment is needed, please send it prior to shipment.

Best regards,
Minsu Lee
